title: Continuous one-mouth force and acceleration, separated-mouth energy and radius/attachment tests
scope: Exploratory 0PN, scalar coherent carrier with fixed or massless constrained wall. All numbers in model units. Harmonic forces are first-order amplitudes.
guard: Per-job zero swap; no elapsed-time limit. The source_files map identifies the on-disk source used by each run; file_sha256 below pins that source. Failed jobs have no accepted physics outputs.

diagnostic_corrections: The original acceleration diagnostic printed rest_potential_norm outside the no-drain velocity experiment. Only the dedicated no_drain_kinetic_check has that interpretation. A later mesh-matched zero-flow control uses the corrected output condition.
The mixed excitation in the free-center solver checks superposition of the same two inputs. It does not constitute an independent nonlinear drive.
An unused rate-compensation output option in the first two radius scripts was removed. All production runs left it unset.

Two original noninteger radii failed bath-mask initialization and the initial radius-one sweep failed the signed current check. The revised runs fixed the bath-coordinate comparison and tightened stationarity. A separate physical-coordinate method tests finite-bias intake by a phase-energy derivative.

Two depth-selection scans detected a misclassified corner at the intersection of the receiving plane and the remote side. The follow-up uses mesh connectivity to identify both ends of the receiver; the independent physical mask check remains in force.

Five outer-28 attempts with the first stationary method failed mesh or convergence checks. Four physical-coordinate finite-bias radii passed in that geometry. Radius 0.25 failed the independent energy derivative. Both outer-40 dipoles failed their equation-residual threshold. Missing finite-bias outputs are excluded.

review.verdict: The steady and dynamic equations, force signs and angular factors agree with the independent derivation.
review.qualification: A sharp outlet corner limits open wall partitions; small towing residuals differ between estimators and domains. No claim of exact vanishing or numerical sign.

review.verdict: The boosted and unboosted implementations agree on the signs of the moving-wall source, the pressure force on the wall, and the external push.
review.qualification: Slow harmonic response with a prescribed feed phase and one rigid shape. No direct finite two-body release.

review.verdict: Scoped clear for the finite-bath comparison.
review.qualification: The fixed phase is an external preparation. The weak test measures conductance over zero-drain mass. The finite-bias force and mass use the same dipole/volume method as the baseline.

review.verdict: The attraction sign and normalization are correct for the reduced conservative carrier model at fixed common reservoir phase drop.
review.qualification: Finite diagonals with infinite mutual kernels, radial shapes supplied, no finite-distance polarization or mutual inertia. The local force and pair-energy forces must not be added.

review.verdict: The code and recorded outputs agree with the two-coordinate derivation.
review.qualification: Fractions concern specified generalized coordinates. Tension thresholds apply to a prescribed held-force pattern in a conservative two-coordinate model. A real harmonic stream can have other pressure/velocity loads.

review.verdict: The observed shape derivatives, energy comparisons and restoring-force exclusion were independently checked.
review.qualification: Reviewer: “The three implementations and guarded outputs support the conditional exclusion.” Calibration is to the same reference geometry. A positive curvature indicates a minimum in this axial deformation; equal weak conductance per carrier mass is conditional as a free-fall proxy. No global uniqueness or statement about physical occupation is implied.

formal_status: Independent local review only. Formal build and record review pending.
